findings.element: Clear-X inside every filter trigger, wizard step 2 (Kantone, TU's, and the other four .custom-select-trigger controls)
findings.finding: The clear-X sits at the horizontal centre of the filter trigger, so clicking the middle of a filled filter — the natural way to reopen it — silently wipes the selection instead of opening the panel.
findings.user_impact: An analyst refining filters destroys work they already did with a click aimed at reopening a list, gets no warning or undo, and can run an evaluation on a filter set that quietly reverted to 'All'.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the clear-X to the far right edge of the trigger (icon at the trailing end, not centred by space-between) and shrink its hit area so the centre of the control always opens the panel.

evidence.action: Set Kantone to ['AG'], then clicked the horizontal centre of the 542px-wide trigger (x≈789); repeated on TU's with ['BLS']. elementFromPoint was measured at that coordinate.
evidence.observed: elementFromPoint returned 'canton-clear' / 'tu-clear'. Kantone state went ['AG'] → [], label reverted to 'All cantons', and the panel did not open; TU's went ['BLS'] → []. No message or undo appeared.

findings.element: Scheduled reports → Edit action (wizard opened with title 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich' and a 'Scheduled' badge)
findings.finding: Editing a scheduled report opens the wizard labelled with that schedule's name but loads none of its saved configuration, and hides the schedule section entirely.
findings.user_impact: The user believes they are adjusting an existing schedule while actually looking at a blank default config, so saving replaces a working schedule with wrong period/TU/canton/line settings — and the frequency they came to change cannot even be seen.
findings.suggested_fix: Hydrate the wizard from the stored schedule (period, TUs, cantons, lines, frequency) on Edit and keep the schedule section visible and editable in that mode.

evidence.action: Opened Geplante Berichte and clicked Edit on 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich'.
evidence.observed: Wizard opened with the schedule's name in the title and a 'Scheduled' badge, but state.selectedPeriod had reset to 'cur_month' and TU/cantons/lines were all empty; the schedule section was hidden so the frequency was neither shown nor changeable.

findings.element: Evaluations list rows with status 'Fertig' — all Rohdaten Export, Linienanalyse DPM and Datenqualitätsindex rows
findings.finding: More than half of the finished evaluations have no 'Anzeigen' button and no clickable row name, so a completed report of those three types cannot be opened at all.
findings.user_impact: An analyst who waited for a report to finish reaches a dead end — the row says 'Fertig' but there is no path to the result, so the whole create-and-read task fails for those report types.
findings.suggested_fix: Give every 'Fertig' row an open path — make the row name the primary link and show 'Anzeigen' on all finished rows regardless of report type.

evidence.action: Enumerated all 28 list rows and attempted to open finished rows by both the action button and the row name.
evidence.observed: Only 9 of 28 rows carry an 'Anzeigen' button; 10 of the 19 'Fertig' rows have none, and the row name has no onclick and cursor:auto, so clicking it does nothing.

findings.finding: Kantone is the only one of the six filter panels that closes after the first pick, so it behaves differently from five identical-looking controls on the same screen.
findings.user_impact: A user who adds one canton and keeps clicking to add a second is thrown out of the panel, has to reopen it, and — because reopening means clicking the trigger centre — lands on the clear-X and loses the canton they had; adding a second canton by mouse failed outright.
findings.suggested_fix: Make Kantone keep its panel open after a selection, exactly like RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien and Haltestellen.

evidence.action: Picked one option in each of the six filter panels, then attempted a second pick in each without reopening.
evidence.observed: RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien and Haltestellen stayed open and accumulated ('All TU' → 'BLS' → 'BLS, CJ'); Kantone closed on the first pick and a second canton could not be added by mouse in two attempts.

findings.element: 'Run Now' button on wizard step 3 with the schedule box ticked
findings.finding: Running an evaluation that also has a schedule configured confirms only the immediate run and the schedule never appears in Geplante Berichte, leaving no way to tell whether it was saved.
findings.user_impact: The user assumes their recurring report is set up, never sees it in the scheduled list, and either loses the schedule silently or re-creates it repeatedly.
findings.suggested_fix: Have the confirmation state both outcomes ('Started now · weekly schedule saved') and make the new schedule appear immediately in Geplante Berichte.

evidence.action: On step 3, ticked the schedule box, set a frequency, clicked 'Run Now', then opened Geplante Berichte.
evidence.observed: Toast read 'Evaluation started — running now' with no mention of the schedule, the app returned to the list, and the new schedule was not present in Geplante Berichte.

gaps: Notify-by-email toggle + email input (step 3): never exercised, so whether a scheduled report communicates its delivery target to the user is unknown.
No loading/progress state is recorded anywhere — after 'Run Now' the map records only a toast and a return to the list, so it is unknown what an evaluation in progress shows the user while it runs.
Failed status: the Status filter offers 'Failed' but the map records no failed-row detail, so whether a failed evaluation explains what went wrong or how to retry could not be checked.

Reversed custom date range (20.08.2026 → 01.08.2026) was accepted at step 1 with Next enabled, but the wizard was not driven to completion with that range, so what the user finally sees or gets is unrecorded.

Cascade between filters is recorded only as 'did not visibly narrow the Linien list' — it is not recorded whether cascading is intended, so whether an impossible canton/TU/line combination can be committed is unknown.

Login 'Passwort vergessen?' and the topbar nav (Startseite / Q.Reports / Fotoalbum / Q-Messungen) are dead by construction (onclick="return false") and were not exercised — their real recovery/navigation behaviour is unknown.
